study_family_overlap_policy: Original NCTs distinct from 10 ADC development studies, V1/V2/V3 earlier studies, V4 reserved, and consumed V5.

sources.name: VERITAC-2
sources.context: ER+/HER2- advanced post-CDK4/6 endocrine setting; subgroup ESR1 mutant vs full population, primary PFS

expected.subgroup: Full trial population, P=.07, not significant

sources.negative_findings: Full-population PFS not significantly better than fulvestrant; must not claim overall randomized PFS win.

sources.name: SERENA-2
sources.context: Postmenopausal ER+/HER2- advanced, camizestrant 75mg and 150mg vs fulvestrant, primary PFS, source erratum PMID40049203
other_effects_unscored: 150mg HR 0.64 (0.46–0.89) in original abstract, CI level not explicitly adjacent; do not invent the level
sources.negative_findings: 2025 erratum; original source version and corrections require expert review before medical communication.

sources.name: DESTINY-Breast02
sources.context: HER2-positive metastatic after T-DM1, Daiichi Sankyo/AstraZeneca ADC vs physician choice, PFS primary; serious ILD safety signal
other_effects_unscored: PFS HR 0.36 [0.28–0.45] appears in abstract without an explicitly attached CI level; do not infer 95% from separate arm median confidence intervals
sources.negative_findings: Drug-related ILD ~10% with two grade-5 deaths in T-DXd treated arm; comparator details, denominator, source tables and study version require review.

rules: Scores only exact candidate tuples predeclared before execution; never promote absent/unlabelled CI to sourced outcome. Distinct patient populations, publication corrections and serious harms remain specialist-review flags.
